brand.$description: Pesa Red. A fill only: the lead (hero) card and the one main action per screen, plus danger. White text on it: 5.9:1.

brandLink.$description: The brand accent: links, the current tab, progress bars and chosen options.

brandSoft.$description: The soft neutral fill behind a chosen chip, menu choice or side of a switch, with the accent on it.

background.$description: Neutral page tone so white cards stand off it.

success.$description: Fills and icons. For success text on white use successText.

warningStrong.$description: The worse of two warnings, such as Struggling beside Coping: a deeper orange, kept clear of brand red.

danger.$description: Same red as brand; always pair with an icon or label ("Over").

dangerText.$description: Danger in small text: the same red as danger in light.

markBlue.$description: Only for marking the parts of a message (who). 5.6:1 on its tint.

markPurple.$description: Only for marking the parts of a message (balance). 5.8:1 on its tint.

markTeal.$description: Only for marking the parts of a message (fee). 4.6:1 on its tint.

selected.$description: A neutral tint for quiet fills, such as the Ask bar.

background.$description: Soft dark page, a neutral grey rather than near black. The high-contrast setting keeps #0A0A0A.

floating.$description: Tab bar, sheets, menus, popups. No drop shadows in dark.

text.$description: Moderate, not maximal, contrast: 14.2:1 on background, 12.9:1 on surface.

brand.$description: Same red as light, a fill only: 2.9:1 on surface, so red text, large red figures and red edges on dark use brandLink.

onBrand.$description: White text on the red fill (5.9:1).

brandLink.$description: The brand accent on dark: the brand red lifted for text, large figures, edges and thin strokes, never pink. 5.8:1 on background, 5.3:1 on surface.

brandSoft.$description: A soft neutral tint behind the accent, never pink.

warningStrong.$description: The worse of two warnings, kept clear of brand red.

danger.$description: Same as dark brand, a fill only (a destructive button, white text 5.9:1); always pair with an icon or label.

dangerText.$description: Brand red's hue brightened for danger text and large figures below zero: 4.7:1 on floating, 5.3:1 on surface.

selected.$description: A neutral tint for quiet fills, never pink.
